name: Mozart's Name Day: Third
source:
The third installment of "Mozart's Name Day - Halloween stories for music lovers."

The title "syncopes" may refer to the musical effect heard in the first measures of Symphony KV183, but also to the loss of rational consciousness.
translation:
“莫扎特命名日 - 音乐爱好者的万圣节故事”的第三部分。

标题“晕厥”可能指的是交响曲KV183第一小节中听到的音乐效果，但也指理性意识的丧失。
